title: The Escape Game

services.name: Custom Escape Rooms
services.desc: Featuring immersive, easter-egg-puzzles, players stepped into the shoes of everyone’s favorite crime-solving trio. The game premiered in NYC and LA, garnering attention from the New York Times, Adweek, Timeout, and more. We partnered with Nickelodeon to create an escape room celebrating the 30th anniversary of Rugrats. Fans got to step in the home of Tommy Pickles and help find the "losted" toys. Rugrats fans loved it, many dressing up as the iconic babies for the experience. The game ran for 2 years and became a favorite of Rugrats fans and puzzle enthusiasts alike.
